description: A single-panel table rendered as an image, reporting CALPHAD (Thermo-Calc) single-point equilibrium calculations for a low-density high entropy steel at five temperatures. The columns are headed "Condition", "Predicted Phases" and "Mol". At 1200°C (1473 K) the only predicted phase is Liquid (contains Fe, Mn, Ni, Al, Si, C) with Mol = 1.0. At 1100°C (1373 K) the table lists Liquid 0.40, BCC_A2#1 (contains Fe, Mn, Ni, Al, Si, C) 0.48 and B2 (contains Ni, Al) 0.12. At 800°C (1073 K): BCC_A2#1 0.75, B2 0.23 and BCC_A2#2 (contains Mn, C) 0.02. At 500°C (773 K): BCC_A2#1 0.69, B2 0.28, BCC_A2#2 0.02 and M3Si (contains Fe, Mn, Si) 0.01. At 300°C (573 K): BCC_A2#1 0.26, B2 0.29, BCC_A2#2 0.02, M3Si 0.11 and BCC_A2#3 (contains Fe, Mn, Si) 0.32. The Mol values sum to 1.0 at every temperature. The table therefore shows liquid present only down to 1100°C (solidification between 1200 and 1100°C), a BCC_A2#1 + B2 solid state below that, B2 ordering rising steadily on cooling, and two additional phases (M3Si silicide below 500°C and BCC_A2#3 at 300°C) forming at low temperature.

observations.observation: The table has exactly three columns headed 'Condition', 'Predicted Phases' and 'Mol'.
At 1200°C (1473 K) the single predicted phase is 'Liquid (contains Fe, Mn, Ni, Al, Si, C)' with Mol = 1.0.
At 1100°C (1373 K) three phases coexist: Liquid (0.40), BCC_A2#1 (contains Fe, Mn, Ni, Al, Si, C) (0.48) and B2 (contains Ni, Al) (0.12).
The liquid phase present at 1200°C and 1100°C is absent from the 800°C, 500°C and 300°C rows, so solidification is bracketed between 1100°C and 800°C.
BCC_A2#1 is the majority phase from 800°C (0.75) through 500°C (0.69) but drops to 0.26 at 300°C.
The B2 mole fraction increases monotonically on cooling from 0.12 (1100°C) to 0.23 (800°C), 0.28 (500°C) and 0.29 (300°C).
M3Si (contains Fe, Mn, Si) first appears at 500°C with Mol = 0.01 and rises to 0.11 at 300°C.
BCC_A2#3 (contains Fe, Mn, Si) appears only at 300°C, with Mol = 0.32, the second largest fraction at that temperature.
BCC_A2#2 is reported at 0.02 at every temperature from 800°C downwards, and is annotated '(contains Mn, C)' only in the 800°C row.
The caption states these data are single-point equilibrium results of the high entropy steel at different temperatures obtained by CALPHAD modelling using Thermo-Calc software.
The caption/title identifies the material as the low-density high entropy steel Fe40Mn19Ni15Al15Si10C1.

The table gives no composition column, no reference to a database or thermodynamic description, and no Gibbs energy or enthalpy values — only temperature, phase name, contained elements and mole fraction.

subfigures.description: A three-column table ('Condition', 'Predicted Phases', 'Mol') listing equilibrium phase assemblages and their mole fractions at 1200°C (1473 K), 1100°C (1373 K), 800°C (1073 K), 500°C (773 K) and 300°C (573 K). Every row and every 'Mol' value is legible; no header or cell is cropped.
